notes: One row per surface in perf/surfaces.json: either the Kotlin screen that draws it, or the reason the app does not have one. A row may also be a port that is switched off ("enabled": false plus a reason) - the screen exists in the tree and the shell hands the route to the document until the port is the same screen as the page (#872, ADR-0117). docs/mobile/screens.md is generated from this file by npm run check:screens, which fails on a surface with no row and on a *Screen.kt with no row. The rules: docs/mobile/two-clients.md (#665).
